head: 1884c7ae0f46a152e2502bb8d4dd6276a0276a7e
scope: PM4 plant-variety SOP implementation and narrowed KC2/related-metabolite assessment
plant_variety: Candidate rationale; not an experimentally discovered threshold or causal PM4 practice by itself.
CKD crossover; 28 randomised, 25 completers; six weeks per diet
SOP PASS WITH LIMITATIONS: microbial gene-potential changes address PM4 capacity. Whole-pattern intervention, not plant-count isolation; no measured flux.
Separate formulation candidate retained in research. Compositional changes do not independently establish substrate-processing activity; health-rank null and analysis exclusions remain.
kc_evidence: Dietary ellagitannins / ellagic acid → urolithin production
Existing PM6 precursor records; Selma 2014 and Pidgeon 2025 culture/ex-vivo evidence
Production route supported, with substrate and active-community dependencies.
Production is the PM6 operation; it is not independently a shared host-maintenance constraint.
https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-025-56266-2
Conversion capacity can be restored in vivo
Iglesias-Aguirre 2023: oral consortia transferred producer phenotypes to non-producing Wistar rats
Causal evidence that community composition can constrain production.
The reported experiment does not establish consequent changes in both junction function and mucus maintenance.
https://pubs.rsc.org/en/content/articlelanding/2023/fo/d2fo03957e
Urolithin A → junction-regulatory function
Singh 2019: epithelial experiments and mouse injury models; functional leak assays and junction proteins
Supports an experimental downstream regulatory relationship.
Direct compound administration, not loss/restoration of dietary precursor conversion; synthetic UAS03 must remain separate.
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30626868/
Precursor and metabolite are not interchangeable
Hering 2021: differentiated Caco-2 and HT-29/B6 models
Ellagic acid strengthened selected barrier measures; urolithin A had context-specific protection.
Electrical resistance, size-selective permeability and cytokine injury differ. Urolithin A did not reduce every probe flux.
https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7987831/
Urolithin A → mucus
Yasuda 2024: mouse MUC2 protein/mucus thickness and LS174T cells
Supports a distinct PM3-relevant operation; junction transcript changes were not observed in the same mouse experiment.
Direct UroA dosing, including 100 mg/kg twice daily in the mouse protocol; no equivalent ordinary-food dose established. Antagonist validation and dysbiosis mediation limitations remain.
https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-024-65791-x
Urolithin A → mucosal immunity
Ghosh 2026: epithelial AHR/NLRP6 experiments and treated IBD biopsies
Supports an IL-18/IL-22, MUC2/REG3γ response with cell-specific dependencies.
Direct compound/biopsy exposures do not establish dietary-conversion limitation in humans. Same research programme as earlier Jala-group work is not wholly independent replication.
https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-026-73760-3
Human AHR response is context-dependent
Muku 2018: human reporter/binding and Caco-2 experiments
UroA and UroB antagonised induced AHR transcription; UroA had AHR-dependent anti-inflammatory effects.
Do not universally label UroA an AHR agonist or treat human/mouse reporter and epithelial contexts as interchangeable. This does not negate all downstream effects.
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30501068/
Dietary exposure differs from direct supplementation
Singh 2022: pomegranate-precursor versus direct UroA exposure
Demonstrates variable generation and circulating exposure, and bypass by direct administration.
Circulating conjugates/urinary output are not measurements of free local epithelial exposure or function. No claim that all dietary local concentrations are inadequate.
https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8821002/
Human polyphenol pattern / metabotype
MaPLE 2021 and post-hoc Meroño 2022
Pattern and metabotype-dependent serum zonulin associations support further investigation.
Same cohort; urolithin A/conjugates did not significantly correlate with zonulin. A surrogate cannot establish the two PM operations or causal mediation.
https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0963996922006901
Walnut exposure / human tissue context
Liu 2024 and related 2025 walnut-cohort analyses
Dietary walnuts generate variable urolithin exposure; inflammatory/tissue associations broaden relevance.
Related 39-participant cohort analyses are not independent trials; observational converter comparisons do not prove urolithin-dependent junction and mucus outcomes.
https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11979956/
Real-world tannin feeding
Correa 2026: piglet tannin-blend feeding, metagenome/metabolome and farm-dependent diarrhoea outcome
Substrate exposure and microbial context influence metabolite patterns.
Mixed tannins, pen/farm context and network correlations do not isolate UroA mediation or two epithelial operations.
https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s40104-026-01503-x
Fermented pomegranate products
Zhang 2023: strains produced UroA and fermented products affected C. elegans ageing/mitochondrial endpoints
Production plus a bounded bioactivity chain exists in a different organism/endpoint.
Does not test intestinal tight-junction or mucus maintenance; not a probiotic/food recommendation.
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37040550/
Other target: equol
Purified equol feeding in IUGR piglets, 50 mg/kg feed
Junction-related and mucin-related transcripts changed, with serum injury/permeability proxies.
Daidzein conversion was bypassed. Transcripts/proxies do not directly establish restored tight-junction function or mucus-layer maintenance; no shared dietary constraint.
https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10177536/
Other target: enterolactone
Bess 2020 cooperative lignan conversion; 2018 epithelial ENL experiments
Mechanistic conversion and direct epithelial barrier effects are supported in separate systems.
No reviewed bridge establishing the same precursor/conversion constraint on mucus/immune maintenance. Flax cyclic peptides are not enterolactone or interchangeable with lignans.
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30145469/
Other targets: urolithin B / isourolithin A
Metabotype and conversion studies distinguish the products
Distinct products and pathway branches deserve preservation.
Do not inherit UroA junction/mucus findings or treat all urolithins as one active exposure; no supported paired constraint identified.
https://www.nature.com/articles/s41522-025-00849-w
pm_dependency_map: Substrate and machinery limitation of generation supported
Retain existing precursor admissions; conversion remains PM6 biology.
Direct UroA/EA experimental effects; dietary-conversion constraint unresolved
Retain as bounded regulatory research; no new admission or causal KC edge.
Mucus maintenance and mucosal immune regulation
Direct UroA mucus/immune effects; dietary-conversion constraint unresolved
Retain source evidence for independent PM review; do not transfer mouse exposures to foods.
Secondary barrier/endotoxin changes do not prove same-resource limitation
No new KC applicability; keep prior decisions.
New defined plant-pattern SOP; no polyphenol-specific resource attribution
Plant pattern belongs to SOP, not KC constituent or isolated polyphenol admission.
SCFA-associated taxa or concentrations do not demonstrate polyphenol-limited production
No new KC applicability or SCFA substrate admission.
No reviewed source establishes the required resource-to-neural engagement chain
Fibre/tryptophan and associated pathways do not establish a shared polyphenol resource

kc_decision.reason: The narrowed review supports generation and several regulatory activities, but not a distinct shared nutritional constraint across PM1 and PM3. No universal deficiency, human clinical benefit or numerical threshold was demanded.
kc_decision.approval_boundary: The preceding reassessment instruction requires approval before canonical KC modification. This report supplies the concrete retirement outcome and dependency manifest; no KC status, identity or route has changed.
preserve: Existing KC2 ID/route and original ambition as historical provenance, with canonical retirement convention selected during implementation.
Existing PM6 ellagitannin/ellagic-acid admissions, Findings and food mappings.
All PM1/PM3 scientific records and hypotheses; new source leads remain research until independently admitted.
Historical KC flags, unresolved/non-application adjudications and bibliography.
All SEC/CC and Dietary Confidence history; all approved nutrient/food roll-up decisions.
implementation_steps: Register retirement using the existing retired-KC registry convention after approval.
Remove active KC2 listings from BRS5 hub and FM2 while retaining applicable PM dietary practices independently.
Reconcile eight PM candidate/adjudication references as historical records without silently converting unresolved to biologically rejected.
Archive legacy hub guidance and FM2 claimed shared-pool text before replacing active KC-specific assertions.
Reconcile schema example and generated mapping references through approved regeneration; historical review snapshots remain immutable.

Archive the full KC page and former route in review history and the retired registry; remove its live public KC route under the existing retirement rules. Do not invent a redirect or duplicate PMs/KCs.

implementation.finding: PM4-F2 extended; no new duplicate Finding
implementation.food_strategy_projection: 35→36 strategies; 38→39 relationships; all previous entries preserved

research_stop: Searched plant-pattern interventions; urolithin substrate/conversion manipulation; direct junction and mucus/immune effects; exposure/biotransformation and human translation; other urolithins, equol and enterolactone. Located no study in this bounded review establishing the claimed shared constraint. This is not evidence that such a relationship cannot exist.
